milestones: Local development, persistence, project and contract APIs, and the React shell.
Compare contracts, gather evidence, and show a cited impact report.
Hybrid retrieval, metadata filters, source citations, and a curated evaluation set.
Persisted sessions, orchestration, migration planning, and clarification.
Approval before migration-task creation and typed SSE events.
Five Copilot operations plus provider and consumer demo servers.
End-to-end traces, metrics, and diagnosable failure paths.
Release evaluation, deployment environment, and reproducible demo.

issues.title: Add PostgreSQL models, migrations, and database readiness
acceptance: SQLAlchemy 2 models and Alembic migrations initialize projects and contracts.
Enable pgvector through a migration; database readiness is distinct from process liveness.
Integration tests apply migrations to real PostgreSQL and verify rollback/error behavior.

issues.title: Implement project creation and validated contract uploads
acceptance: Create and list projects; persist versioned OpenAPI 3.x documents.
Reject malformed, oversized, and unsupported inputs with actionable errors.
Tests cover duplicate versions, project isolation, and upload failures.

issues.title: Build project and contract selection screens
acceptance: Create/select a project and upload two contract versions through React.
Loading, empty, success, and validation states are accessible.
Component tests and one browser flow cover project creation and upload.

issues.title: Wrap oasdiff and normalize deterministic contract changes
acceptance: A pinned oasdiff executable compares selected contract versions.
Normalize breaking and non-breaking changes with stable IDs and evidence paths.
Tests cover field removal, additions, unchanged contracts, timeout, and invalid tool output.
Invoke the tool with validated argument arrays and no shell interpolation.

issues.title: Add repository-scoped exact code search
acceptance: Return file paths, line numbers, and snippets using ripgrep.
Restrict reads to the selected repository and reject path traversal.
Tests cover no matches, special characters, binary files, and tool failure.

issues.title: Create the provider interface and cited impact report flow
acceptance: Typed provider interface supports a deterministic fake for CI and one live model adapter.
Combine contract facts, code matches, and retrieved source IDs into a validated impact report.
Failed tools and missing evidence are explicit; unknown citations are rejected.
Tests cover invalid structured output, bounded retries, and partial evidence.

issues.title: Display contract changes and end-to-end impact reports
acceptance: Select a change and show severity, explanation, affected files, and source citations.
A deterministic end-to-end test runs the upload-to-report workflow without paid APIs.
UI shows evidence gaps and retryable errors.

issues.title: Ingest documentation with chunk metadata and initial retrieval
acceptance: Upload text documentation and persist chunks with project, API version, type, and source IDs.
Provide initial keyword retrieval for the first vertical slice.
Tests cover duplicate ingestion, empty documents, and project/version filtering.

issues.title: Add pgvector embeddings and hybrid retrieval
acceptance: Combine PostgreSQL full-text and vector search with documented rank fusion.
Use a replaceable embedding provider and deterministic test embeddings.
Integration tests verify metadata filtering and source attribution.

issues.title: Create retrieval and contract-diff evaluation datasets
acceptance: Use public or synthetic fixtures and explicit expected relevant sources.
Measure Recall@5 against the target of at least 80%.
Contract scenarios assert expected breaking changes and report regressions.
Publish machine-readable evaluation results in CI.

issues.title: Persist sessions and resumable orchestrator state
acceptance: Persist running, waiting_for_user, waiting_for_approval, completed, and failed states.
The orchestrator owns agent/tool routing; agents do not call one another.
Tests cover restart/resume, duplicate requests, and failed transitions.

issues.title: Implement migration planning and clarification
acceptance: Return ordered steps, test checklist, open questions, and proposed task.
Ask for missing required context and resume from the stored answer.
Validate structured output and test incomplete or conflicting evidence.

issues.title: Enforce persisted approval before migration-task creation
acceptance: Display proposed task and require an explicit approve/reject decision.
Execute each approved action at most once; rejection never creates a task.
Tests cover unauthorized, stale, repeated, and concurrent decisions plus restart/resume.

issues.title: Stream typed UI events and render trusted components
acceptance: SSE supports reconnect/resume and typed message, plan, source, tool, report, approval, and error events.
React renders only trusted components; model-supplied HTML/JavaScript is never executed.
Tests cover disconnects, unknown event types, and approval interactions.

issues.title: Expose the five Copilot MCP operations
acceptance: Implement get_contract, list_contract_versions, compare_contracts, search_api_docs, and get_change_details.
Validate inputs, preserve project scoping, and return structured errors.
Protocol tests cover every operation and invalid requests.

issues.title: Connect provider and consumer MCP demos
acceptance: Configure and query both demo MCP servers from the orchestrator.
Timeouts and unavailable servers produce evidence gaps without fabricated results.
Integration tests pin compatible demo revisions and cover connection failure.

issues.title: Add OpenTelemetry tracing and local Jaeger
acceptance: Trace every agent, LLM, tool, RAG, MCP, and approval execution.
Record latency, token counts, retrieval IDs, errors, and approval wait time.
Exclude secrets and sensitive raw content from logs.
Tests assert trace propagation and a documented local Jaeger demo works.

issues.title: Add full demo regression and optional live-model evaluation
acceptance: Exercise contract upload through approved migration-task creation and resumed sessions.
Mandatory CI uses fakes; live evaluations require manual dispatch and scoped secrets.
Report retrieval quality, contract correctness, approval safety, trace coverage, and latency.

issues.title: Configure a staging host and deployment with rollback
acceptance: Select hosting and document expected cost before provisioning paid resources.
Deploy tested immutable GHCR image digests through a protected staging environment.
Configure secrets, persistent PostgreSQL, migrations, readiness checks, and rollback.
Smoke tests verify the deployed app; production deployment remains a separate decision.

issues.title: Document the release checklist and reproducible demo
acceptance: Document configuration, startup, test commands, MCP setup, and a complete example.
Record demo repository revisions and publish release notes.
Confirm PRD release criteria and document known limitations.

issues.title: Choose a license for the public repositories
acceptance: The owner chooses the intended license and copyright holder.
Add consistent LICENSE files and dependency attribution where needed.

issues.title: Expand versioned API fixtures and migration documentation
acceptance: Add removed endpoints, required request fields, type changes, and non-breaking additions.
Document expected oasdiff results for each scenario.
Verify checked-in contracts match the provider implementation.

issues.title: Expose provider metadata through MCP
acceptance: Implement get_openapi_spec, get_api_version, and get_changelog with the Python MCP SDK.
Reject unknown versions and file traversal; expose only intended fixture resources.
Protocol tests exercise all operations and structured failures.

issues.title: Expand realistic consumer integrations and migration tests
acceptance: Add example usages corresponding to provider breaking-change fixtures.
Demonstrate v1 success, v2 incompatibility, and an explicit migration example.
Keep tests deterministic with mocked HTTP and no production credentials.

issues.title: Expose repository evidence through MCP
acceptance: Implement search_code, get_file, and list_dependencies.
Scope paths to the demo checkout, reject traversal and symlink escapes, and cap output sizes.
Protocol tests verify exact paths/lines and unavailable resources.
